clearedSpotChecks.check: Per-transaction transient reset and dropped logs of failed frames on MegaETH's producer, from mined data over blocks 31,500,479 to 32,158,191.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched eth_getBlockReceipts for block 31,508,965. The three listed transactions with a failed inner unlock (indexes 12, 16, 18) have status 1 and no PoolManager log, and the later transactions at indexes 45, 53 and 75 each carry a PoolManager Swap log (topic 0x40e9cecb). The code is as cited: unlock reverts with AlreadyUnlocked while the lock is set and with CurrencyNotSettled on a nonzero delta count, and it locks again before returning (src/PoolManager.sol:103-113). The wording goes slightly too far. A successful unlock always ends with the lock reset and the delta count at zero, and a failed one is unwound by the revert, so this data shows that reverts unwind transient storage on the producer. It does not show a reset between transactions, because nothing was left set to reset. The only value that can survive a successful transaction is the synced currency and its reserves: sync is not gated by onlyWhenUnlocked (src/PoolManager.sol:279-288), and _settle reads that value (src/PoolManager.sol:349-364, src/libraries/CurrencyReserves.sol). The unit says this is not shown and leaves it as an open lead, so the clear holds with that limit.

leads.question: In the producer source (mega-evm 1.7.4 with revm 40.0.3, and Monad's execution at 0.16.7), find where transient storage is cleared between transactions in a block, and check whether a transaction that ends after a bare PoolManager sync(token) can leave CURRENCY_SLOT and RESERVES_OF_SLOT set for the next transaction. From mined data as well: find a transaction on MegaETH or Monad that ends with a PoolManager sync open (sync with no settle after it) and a later transaction in the same block that settles before its own sync, and check that the producer's receipt for the later one equals the replica's re-execution.
leads.why: Mined data cannot show this reset. sync is callable without unlock (src/PoolManager.sol:279-288), and a stale synced currency changes what _settle credits or makes it revert for the next settler (src/PoolManager.sol:349-364). Reading the source would settle the question without waiting for a mined example.
